description: RealiTLScanner (XTLS): scans IP addresses, CIDR ranges or domains for TLS 1.3 servers with HTTP/2 that can serve as the camouflage target (dest and serverNames) of Xray's REALITY; saves them to a CSV file.
notes: Commands: realitlscanner (the scanner) and realitlscanner-scan (one range once, results kept across updates).
Scoop Apps: 'RealiTLScanner' shows examples; 'RealiTLScanner scan' asks for a range and scans it.
Results of realitlscanner-scan: ~\scoop\persist\RealiTLScanner\results (kept on update; 'scoop uninstall -p' deletes them).
Upstream recommends running it from home, not from a VPS: scanning from a server may get it flagged.
Results go to out.csv in the CURRENT folder (overwritten on every run; change with -out).
GeoIP country codes: install gesu/Loyalsoldier-GeoIP and the realitlscanner command uses its Country.mmdb.
A Country.mmdb in the current folder takes precedence. $env:GESU_GEOIP_MMDB = 'Country-without-asn.mmdb'
gives plain country codes instead of CLOUDFLARE, GOOGLE, ...; 'none' turns GeoIP off.
It ignores HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and ALL_PROXY: scans and -url downloads always go direct.

script: # realitlscanner runs this wrapper: the scanner only reads Country.mmdb from its working folder,
# so the wrapper starts it next to a copy of the gesu/Loyalsoldier-GeoIP database (see the package page).
if (!(Test-Path $wrapper)) { error "RealiTLScanner.ps1 is missing from the bucket: install with 'scoop install gesu/RealiTLScanner'."; break }
# 'RealiTLScanner scan': scans one range once, results in the persisted results folder.
# RealiTLScanner.exe prints an error and its flags and exits at once, so the shortcut opens this micro-launcher instead.
':: RealiTLScanner: shows what realitlscanner does and how to run it, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO RealiTLScanner looks for TLS 1.3 servers with HTTP/2 (h2) and a certificate',
'ECHO from a named issuer: candidates for the dest and serverNames of Xray REALITY.',
'ECHO Run it from any console as realitlscanner. Upstream recommends scanning from',
'ECHO home, not from a VPS: scanning from a server may get it flagged.',
'ECHO       Starts at one IP or domain and walks to the neighbouring IPs',
'ECHO       in both directions until you press Ctrl+C',
'ECHO       IPs, ranges or domains from a file, one per line, 10 at a time',
'ECHO       Scans every domain linked from a web page',
'ECHO       Another port, 5-second timeout, also shows failed targets',
'ECHO Results go to out.csv in the current folder (overwritten; change with -out).',
'ECHO Country codes (GEO_CODE) come from gesu/Loyalsoldier-GeoIP when it is installed,',
'ECHO or from a Country.mmdb in the current folder. SET GESU_GEOIP_MMDB=Country-without-asn.mmdb',
'ECHO gives plain country codes instead of CLOUDFLARE, GOOGLE and so on; none turns GeoIP off.',
'ECHO The RealiTLScanner scan shortcut (command realitlscanner-scan) scans one range once',
